scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.test: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,yellow "npm run test --workspace=web" "npm run test:api"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
